reserves.name: Aggregate GBP-value reserve (composition undisclosed)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: VNX Commodities AG and undisclosed reserve issuers or counterparties

sources.label: AREVA VNX reserve report as of December 31, 2024

reserveReview.rationale: AREVA reconciled the December 31, 2024 circulating VGBP liability to at least the same aggregate GBP value held in bank accounts or securities custody accounts. The report does not disclose constituents or weights, while VNX's non-binding policy permits a broader mix of debt securities, ETFs, derivatives, deposits, repos, money-market instruments, and currency hedges. The current VNX transparency page publishes no later VGBP reserve report.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: AREVA aggregate reserve-value reconciliation and VNX non-binding reserve policy
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All reserve value is reported only as an aggregate. The bank-account versus securities-custody allocation, underlying holdings, issuers, maturities, custodians, and liquidity terms are undisclosed.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The AUP report confirms aggregate GBP-value coverage but does not disclose reserve constituents or weights.

providers.name: Undisclosed bank and securities custody counterparties

sources.label: AREVA VNX reserve report as of December 31, 2024

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The AUP report confirms aggregate GBP-value coverage in bank or securities custody accounts but does not name providers, disclose provider shares, establish segregation or bankruptcy remoteness, or state rehypothecation terms.
